blueprint.label: Factory: 1 military-science-pack/s, compact
blueprint.description: 5 rows on shelves, products handed over directly. Inputs enter at the bottom of the west bus, west to east: copper-plate 0.5/s, steel-plate 0.25/s, stone-brick 5/s, iron-plate 2.5/s, coal 5/s, iron-plate 2/s. The product leaves at the top. Connect any pole to your grid.
